review:
Irish Crown is a 5x3, 20-line Irish slot with gems, shamrocks, leprechauns and crowns, plus two bonus rounds. Landing three to nine crowns in the base game awards a Big Money cash prize, and Irish Crown mystery symbols transform into matching icons.

Three bonus symbols trigger 10 free spins, where leprechauns turn symbols into crowns for the rest of the round; one, two or three extra scatters add two, five or ten spins. Landing 10 crowns activates the Big Money Bonus. The RTP is 96.52%. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a max win for this game.
